FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 610
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/17/2026
House Bill 610 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General for the enforcement of this bill; however, these obligations may be offset by any
penalties received from violators of the provisions of this bill and retained by the Attorney
General.
